metal_surface_input_groups.description: Exterior metal RP uses same 4 paintable items as NC — mixed UOM (LF and EA). Engine divides quantity by rate to calculate hours. All protection inputs are LF or SF based.

task_production_rates.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Load truck with metal RP-specific equipment: wire brushes, grinders, needle gun, solvent/degreaser, rust converter, DTM primers, spray equipment, PPE. ~50 min (0.83 hr) — slightly longer than NC (45 min) because RP requires additional condition-specific prep tools (needle gun, rust converter) that NC does not.

defect_tolerance.all: All required tools and materials on site. Staging area established.

task_production_rates.name: Scaffold / Lift Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Scaffold assembly, leveling, safety rail installation, OSHA check. 90 min (1.5 hr) per facade. 2-person crew. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Scaffold level, plumb, safety rails installed. OSHA compliant.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Protection at Metal Base
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Deploy plastic/canvas along metal base. 80 LF/hr midpoint. ~45 sec per LF. Same as NC — protection deployment rate does not change for RP.

defect_tolerance.all: Coverage extends 3-4 ft from base. Edges secured.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Below Metal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Canvas and plastic on walkways/patios. 200 SF/hr. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Complete coverage. Canvas for traffic areas.

task_production_rates.name: Siding Protection Behind Metal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Plastic sheeting on siding behind metal. 150 SF/hr. Spray method only.

defect_tolerance.all: Full plastic cover 4-6 ft on siding.

task_production_rates.name: Light Fixture Bagging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Bag and tape light fixture. 12 EA/hr = ~5 min per fixture.

defect_tolerance.all: Fully bagged. No exposed glass or finish.

task_production_rates.name: Roof Edge Protection for Gutter Work
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Deploy cloth along shingle line above gutter. 60 LF/hr. Conditional on gutter work.

defect_tolerance.all: Cloth secured along shingle line.

task_production_rates.name: Visual & Tactile Condition Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Assess all metal surfaces for rust grade, adhesion, substrate type, profile complexity, contamination. 30 min — RP-specific addition. Covers typical residential scope (4-8 components). Larger projects may need additional time.

defect_tolerance.all: All components assessed. Rust grade, substrate type, adhesion, profile complexity documented.

task_production_rates.name: Coating Adhesion Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ASTM D3359 cross-hatch test on representative areas. 15 min for typical scope.

defect_tolerance.all: Adhesion rated per ASTM D3359. Documented per component.

task_production_rates.name: Structural Rust Gate Check
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Probe all rust areas for structural integrity. 15 min. GATE TASK.

defect_tolerance.all: All rust areas probed. No structural compromise found (PASS) or HARD STOP issued (FAIL).

task_production_rates.name: Lead Paint Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: XRF gun or EPA test kit on existing paint. 15 min. Pre-1978 only.

defect_tolerance.all: Lead test documented. Negative = proceed. Positive = RRP scope.

task_production_rates.name: Power Wash Metal Surfaces
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Power wash metal at 1000-1500 PSI. 120 LF/hr midpoint. ~30 sec per LF. Removes loose rust, chalk, dirt. RP addition — NC bare metal does not need wash.

defect_tolerance.all: All loose material removed. Surface ready for solvent clean.

task_production_rates.name: SP1 Solvent Cleaning
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SSPC-SP1 solvent wipe. 75 LF/hr. ~48 sec per LF. MANDATORY first prep step. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT2: All surfaces wiped. No visible contamination.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All surfaces wiped clean. No visible oil, grease, or contaminants.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All surfaces wiped clean. White rag test passes.

task_production_rates.name: SP2 Hand Tool Prep
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SSPC-SP2 wire brush, scraper, sandpaper. 30 LF/hr. ~2 min per LF. For flash rust and light conditions. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All loose material removed. Feathered smooth.

task_production_rates.name: SP3 Power Tool Prep
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SSPC-SP3 grinder with wire wheel. 18 LF/hr. ~3.3 min per LF. For moderate/heavy rust and failing paint. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Tight rust and failing paint removed from treatment areas.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete removal. Uniform profile. No skip areas.

task_production_rates.name: Needle Gun / Power Scraper for Heavy Scale
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Needle gun or power scraper for heavy rust scale. 10 LF/hr. ~6 min per LF. Most labor-intensive prep task. RP-specific addition — NC bare metal rarely has heavy scale. Precedes SP3 for final profile.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Heavy scale removed from treatment areas.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All scale deposits removed. Ready for SP3.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss Existing Coating
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Scuff-sand or liquid degloss. 50 LF/hr. ~1.2 min per LF. Same rate as NC.

task_production_rates.name: Strip Failing Coating
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove failing coating by scraping/stripping. 15 LF/hr. ~4 min per LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All failing coating removed. Feathered edges.

task_production_rates.name: Aluminum Surface Abrasion
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Scotch-Brite or 180-grit abrasion. 50 LF/hr. Same rate as NC. Must prime within 15 min.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform scuff pattern. Primed within 15 min.

task_production_rates.name: Galvanized Surface Cleaning
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Vinegar/ammonia wash for galvanized. 50 LF/hr. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Oils removed. Water sheeting test passes.

task_production_rates.name: Rust Conversion Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply rust converter. 40 LF/hr. ~1.5 min per LF. 24 hr cure before priming. Same rate as NC.

task_production_rates.name: Post-Prep Dust Clean
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Compressed air, tack cloth, vacuum drop cloths. 100 LF/hr. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Surface free of dust and debris.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Metal-to-Building Junctions
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Polyurethane sealant at junctions. 75 LF/hr. Same as NC.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — DTM Acrylic, Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush DTM acrylic primer on ferrous metal. 20 LF/hr. ~3 min per LF. Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. No runs or sags.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — DTM Acrylic, Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray DTM acrylic primer. 35 LF/hr single operator. RP uses single-operator spray (no back-brush needed on production runs). NC used 2-person for back-brush; RP drops spray_backbrush.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — DTM Alkyd, Brush (Pitted)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush alkyd DTM on pitted ferrous. 20 LF/hr. Same as NC. BLOCKED on galvanized/aluminum.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — Etch Primer, Brush (Non-Ferrous)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush etch primer on galvanized/aluminum. 25 LF/hr. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Thin uniform coat. Complete coverage.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — Bonding Primer, Brush (Sound Non-Ferrous)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush bonding primer on sound existing non-ferrous. 25 LF/hr. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: Complete coverage over deglosed surface.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Bare Areas on Sound Existing
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spot prime bare areas on sound existing. 30 LF/hr. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All bare spots primed. Feathered edges.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat — DTM Acrylic, Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush DTM acrylic finish. 20 LF/hr. Per coat (2 coats total). Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete coverage. No holidays, runs, or sags.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Consistent sheen. No brush marks.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat — DTM Acrylic, Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray DTM acrylic finish. 35 LF/hr single operator. Per coat (2 coats total). RP uses single-operator spray.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete coverage. No runs, sags, or orange peel.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Even sheen. No overspray.

task_production_rates.name: Ornamental Detail Finish (EA)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detail brush on ornamental/misc items. 3 EA/hr = ~20 min/EA. Per coat (2 coats total). Same rate as NC.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Uniform film on all profiles.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection between finish coats. 100 LF/hr. Same as NC final inspect rate.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Scuff Sand (QT4)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Light 220-grit scuff between finish coats. 60 LF/hr. QT4 only.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Defect Repair
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Correct intercoat defects. 30 LF/hr. Rate reflects LF scanned — most passes without repair.

defect_tolerance.all: All defects corrected.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe. 120 LF/hr.

defect_tolerance.all: Surface tack-cloth clean.

task_production_rates.name: Final Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Final visual inspection. 100 LF/hr. Same as NC.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up Defects
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush touch-up. 30 LF/hr. Same as NC.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Protection Materials
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove tarps, plastic, tape. 22 min. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: All protection removed. No tape residue.

task_production_rates.name: Scaffold Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Disassemble scaffold. 75 min. 2-person crew. Same as NC.

defect_tolerance.all: All scaffold removed. No building damage.

task_production_rates.name: Final Site Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Collect debris, clean equipment, dispose hazardous waste. 25 min — slightly more than NC (22 min) because RP generates more hazardous debris (rust converter bottles, solvent rags).

defect_tolerance.all: Work area clean. Hazardous waste disposed.

factor_modifiers.name: Metal Profile Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Profile complexity is the primary labor driver. Standard (simple pickets, straight gutters) = 1.0x. Moderate (multi-plane profiles) = 1.50x. Ornate (historic ironwork, scrollwork) = 2.25x. RP ornate is slightly lower than NC (2.25 vs 2.50) because existing coating partially fills intricate recesses, reducing prep surface area.

factor_modifiers.name: Exterior Access Method Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access method affects production for tasks at elevation. Same values as NC.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: QT modifier for RP. QT2 = 0.85x (reduced inspection, economy prep). QT3 = 1.0x baseline. QT4 = 1.15x (intercoat sand, close-range inspection).

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Modifier (Prep Tasks Only)
factor_modifiers.description: Condition/rust grade drives RP prep cost variance. Applied to PREP TASKS ONLY — once prepped, substrate is normalized. Sound = 1.0x. Flash rust = 1.25x. Moderate rust = 1.60x. Heavy rust = 2.25x. Failing paint = 1.50x.
factor_modifiers.notes: PREP STACKING POOL ONLY. Coating tasks (prime, finish) are NOT affected by condition modifier — substrate is normalized after prep.

prep_tasks.max_stack: Heavy rust (2.25) x Scaffold (1.60) x Ornate (2.25) x QT4 (1.15) = 9.32x — recommend T&M for extreme scenarios
prep_tasks.realistic_worst: Moderate rust (1.60) x Ladder (1.35) x Moderate profile (1.50) x QT3 (1.00) = 3.24x

coating_tasks.max_stack: Scaffold (1.60) x Ornate (2.25) x QT4 (1.15) = 4.14x — exceeds 4.0x cap, flagged

fixed_tasks.notes: Assessment, mobilization, protection, cleanup — no modifiers.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: 50 LF steel railing, sound paint, ground, brush, QT3
time_estimates_by_scenario.breakdown: Mobilize 0.83 + Protect 0.75 + Assess 1.0 + SP1 0.67 + Degloss 1.0 + Spot prime 1.67 + Dust 0.50 + Finish x2 5.0 + Interstage 1.0 + Inspect 0.50 + Touch-up 1.67 + Teardown 0.37 + Cleanup 0.42 = ~15.38 raw -> with modifier = ~5.2 hr effective for baseline scenario
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Sound paint baseline — lightest RP. ~15% premium over equivalent NC time due to assessment module and power wash.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: 50 LF steel railing, moderate rust, ground, brush, QT3
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: SP3 power tool + rust converter adds significant prep time. 24 hr cure for rust converter = 2 mobilizations.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: 100 LF galvanized gutter, flash rust, ladder, spray, QT2
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Production gutter scenario. Spray is efficient but ladder adds repositioning overhead.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: 5 EA ornamental iron, heavy rust, scaffold, brush, QT4
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: FLAG: prep stack = 2.25 x 1.60 x 2.25 x 1.15 = 9.32x — EXCEEDS 4.0x cap. Recommend T&M billing. Needle gun + SP3 + rust converter with 24 hr cure.

worst_case_stack: Heavy rust (2.25) x Scaffold (1.60) x Ornate (2.25) x QT4 (1.15) = 9.32x on prep tasks. Realistic worst: moderate (1.60) x ladder (1.35) x moderate (1.50) x QT3 (1.00) = 3.24x. Coating worst: scaffold (1.60) x ornate (2.25) x QT4 (1.15) = 4.14x — slightly exceeds cap.
